hook: Every spell heats your Lamp: stop at exactly 7 for big buffs, or boil over and Flare.
loop: Cast spells and Phials to build Heat, choosing where to stop
End at your Flashpoint, or go over to Flare
End of Turn and Flare effects buff every Moth permanently

growth.line: From Tier 4, board-wide permanent buffs each turn; Heat resets, so a steady drip, not a climb.

feel.early: Thin; small bodies and a few Phials
feel.late: Big board buffs, Flares mid-fight, Shipton's opening blast

stars.why: Pays double at exactly the Flashpoint: the tribe's idea on one card
Stops a Flare for Simmer; sell her to Boil Over
Moves the Flashpoint to 3, changing what every card reads

card_short.u01: Bristle that grows with your Heat
card_short.u02: Gives you an Uncertain Phial each turn
card_short.u03: End of Turn: buffs a random Moth by Heat
card_short.u04: Each spell you cast Stokes 1 more
card_short.u05: Gain 1 gold once a turn when you cast
card_short.u06: Catches one Flare while recruiting; Heat stays at Flashpoint
card_short.u07: Selling a unit gives you a Phial, twice a turn
card_short.u08: Spells on a neighbour also buff another neighbour
card_short.u09: Drains attackers by half your Heat, then Stokes
card_short.u10: Flare: all other Moths gain permanent stats
card_short.u11: End of Turn: buffs Moths, double at exactly Flashpoint
card_short.u12: Stokes 3 each turn, 2 more on Tier up
card_short.u13: Phials cast twice on the same target
card_short.u14: Spells on a Moth add stats per Heat
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: blasts three enemies by Heat
card_short.u16: Every tribe; a Flare steals a shop unit
card_short.u17: Can't grow; other Moths' End of Turn effects trigger twice
card_short.u18: Flashpoint becomes 3; Stokes 1 after each Flare
card_short.u19: End of Turn: buffs Moths by all Heat gained
card_short.x02: Free spell: +1/+1, then Stoke 0 to 2 at random

builds.name: Simmer at Seven
builds.line: Land on exactly 7 every turn; Spectacle, Compounder, Pavonia pay out

builds.name: Boil Over
builds.line: Flare as often as possible; Brass, Senior, Atropos, Alchymist

builds.name: Lamp in the Fight
builds.line: End at 7; Shipton blasts, Hawk-moth Stokes into mid-fight Flares

liked: One dial, two opposite builds: stop at 7 or blow past it
Cast order with Fanner, Brass and Compounder is a real puzzle
worries: Pavonia with Carbonaria runs far above the Tier 6 top end
Burnt-Ring Senior's in-fight Flares are unlimited with The Alchymist; thin early game
changed: The Uncertain's Phial now Stokes 0 to 2 at random
The Old Lady only stops Flares while recruiting
Clearer timing: Heat resets first, Hawk-moth drains before Stoking, Herald Stokes on Tier up
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 7 distinct, ranked second of three; for players who like counting to an exact mark.
